entries.187191109be284ea: Customers and business partners of the company group
entries.1c538728f614c4fc: A service operated by the consolidated subsidiary COMPASS that provides self-managing landlords, in one stop and through the use of IT, with the work needed for rental property management overall, including finding tenants, rent management and handling move-outs. In the fiscal year ended January 2026, the number of registered owners of the Web service grew to 12,167.
entries.308cb283d36f5206: A rent collection agency service provided in partnership with [[company:ricoh-leasing|RICOH LEASING COMPANY,LTD.]], aimed at improving the efficiency of rent management for landlords and real estate companies. Amounts are disclosed only at the business level, and no amount for this service alone is disclosed.
entries.3302f165f36ab098: A business that guarantees payment of child support.
entries.48c24dea35905501: The core business, under which, when a lease is signed, it enters into a guarantee consignment contract with the tenant and acts as joint guarantor, guaranteeing rent and other payments to the landlord. This business is the only reportable segment, and revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥12,753 million. When underwriting guarantees, it conducts credit management using data from credit information agencies and its own database; when arrears occur, it makes subrogation payments to landlords and real estate companies and then exercises its right of reimbursement against the tenant. The number of contracts held as of January 31, 2026 was 683,602.
entries.5bb0414b1b31fbe6: A business that guarantees payment of child support. Going beyond the provision of guarantees, it supports the independence of single parents through consultation on finding housing, finding work and daily life matters, among other things.
entries.5cdd770c1ace6c64: Businesses other than the rent guarantee business, including rental management support for self-managing landlords and guarantees of child support payments.
entries.5eaa688645f7109c: A business undertaken by consolidated subsidiary Profit Center Co., Ltd., which supports the strengthening of the company group's sales activities and the enhancement of customer touchpoints through outbound and inbound telephone services.
